concept.subject: Two wooden piers reaching into a calm cove, with four life rings floating and bobbing on the water between and below them.
concept.composition: The piers reach in from the left and right edges at two fifths of the height, each a third of the picture wide, their decks sloping gently down toward their tips and leaving open water between them under the cannon. The water's surface lies at half height; four life rings float in a row at three fifths of the height, at 20, 40, 60 and 80 percent of the width, their lower parts under the water. The lower corners are calm water over sand.
concept.layout: 81 round pegs and 63 bricks; the stage's moving elements begin here. The life rings are the platforms template's floaters: rings of curved bricks, open at the bottom where the water hides them, each with a peg inside and each floating on its own small circle. The two pier decks are brick slides that lean toward the middle; the pilings under them are peg columns, and the foam lines on the water are peg lines between the rings.

moving.what: four life rings, each floating on a small circle

difficulty.note: The stage's easiest: the floating rings move slowly and the sloping piers feed the middle.

background.prompt: A calm seaside cove on a sunny day. Two weathered wooden piers on gray-blue pilings reach out from the left and right edges toward the middle at about two fifths of the picture height, each about a third of the picture wide, their decks sloping gently down toward their tips, which stop short of the center and leave a wide gap of open water between them. The cove's clear aqua water fills the lower half of the picture, its calm surface at about half height. Four round life rings in white and pale teal float in a row on the water at about three fifths of the height, evenly spaced at about 20, 40, 60 and 80 percent of the width, each about a tenth of the picture wide, their lower parts below the waterline. Gentle lines of white foam curl along the surface between them. A soft blue sky with a few small clouds fills the top, open at the top center; the lower corners are calm water over pale sand.

picture.title: A stunning view of a wooden pier extending over clear turquoise waters against a blue sky.
picture.author: Abdulhamid Jalab
